desktop.notes:
• Slideshow fades in from your screen straight to the first photo - no black flash.
• Dashboard pace counts only culling: slideshow time is never counted, and neither are pauses longer than 12 s.
• (Test: this version should arrive by itself through Settings → Updates.)
